name: reload-generated
comment: WP-2.G, the reload op on generated terrain (tests/golden/README.md "Reload"), the part of tick/gate2-session that needs no item behaviour. The player (id 0) on the grass at (-25.5, 67, -57.5) walks +z (yaw 0) from t=1; a pig (id 1) is spawned 3 blocks to the side. Population fills the beaches with falling sand, which is still settling at t=30, when the reload saves the world (chunks with entities and every populated chunk; generated-only chunks are never modified and so not saved) and opens it again: the old world's chunks are loaded again in load order, the saved ones from the region files with their entities (new ids, seeded by the join hook), the unsaved ones generated again, which populates neighbours whose 2x2 square completes in the new load order. The new player has no movement input until the input op at t=31. rng_state every tick, every entity every 10 ticks, the player every tick, the player's and the start chunk every 10.
